description: Eight 90-second clips cut from the private 13.9-minute meeting recording at scratch/clip.wav. Cut boundaries were chosen from measured acoustic structure alone (frame RMS, zero-crossing rate, an adaptive noise floor) so that the set is not selected using the system under test. Zero clips carry a human reference: the clips, the schema and the harness exist, the annotations do not.

source.description: A real private meeting recording, 13.9 minutes, mono 16 kHz. Never committed, never published, never uploaded. Every clip is a slice of it.

clips.rationale: The most pause-dense 90 s window in the recording: 45 speech runs, 37 gaps of 300 ms or more, 20 pauses of 700 ms or more, longest 2990 ms. Exercises short-segment handling and the pause threshold in the grouping policy.
The densest window: 76.5 percent speech, only 23 gaps, longest 2030 ms, and the highest median level of any clip. Exercises back-to-back decoding and a high word rate.
Speech 20 dB quieter at the low end than clip01 (5th percentile -94.3 dBFS, floor -49 dBFS against clip01's -40). Exercises the front end on a low-SNR input.
Contains the single longest silence in the whole recording, 5480 ms, most likely a topic change or a dropout. Exercises the chunk planner across a long non-speech region.

The lowest zero-crossing rate over speech frames of any window (900 crossings per second against 1000-1050 elsewhere), i.e. the darkest and slowest-sounding speech in the set. A crude speaking-rate proxy, and labelled as one.
The longest unbroken speech run in the set, 5880 ms, with 36 speech runs over 90 s. The mid-range baseline every other clip is compared against.
The softest speech in the set (95th percentile -15.8 dBFS, 1 dB below every other clip) with a 3460 ms gap. Exercises quiet passages and a near-floor noise estimate.

The quietest and most fragmented window: 47.2 percent speech, 39 gaps of 300 ms or more, 21 pauses of 700 ms or more, and a median level of -85.7 dBFS against -30 to -45 elsewhere. The recording tail, where the VAD has to reject as much as it keeps.
